sql.query: SELECT w.id,w.templateId,w.ownerTeamId,w.currentStageId,fromStage.stageName fromStageName,targetStage.id targetStageId,targetStage.stageName toStageName,fromStage.allowManualOverride,CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.workflowId=w.id AND t.workflowStageId=fromStage.id AND t.tenantId=w.tenantId AND t.isRequired=1 AND t.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped')) AS UNSIGNED) blockingTaskCount,CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.workflowId=w.id AND t.workflowStageId=fromStage.id AND t.tenantId=w.tenantId AND t.isRequired=1 AND t.status IN ('waiting','internal_hold','external_hold')) AS UNSIGNED) onHoldTaskCount,CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.workflowId=w.id AND t.workflowStageId=fromStage.id AND t.tenantId=w.tenantId AND t.isRequired=1 AND t.responseRequired=1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(t.responseValue),'') IS NULL) AS UNSIGNED) missingResponseCount,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.userId=ut.userId AND utr.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 AND (r.tenantId IS NULL OR r.tenantId=ut.tenantId) INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='tenant.workflow.stage.override' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.userTenantId=ut.id AND tm.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND tm.teamId=w.ownerTeamId AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_member_roles tmr ON tmr.teamMemberId=tm.id AND tmr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_roles tr ON tr.id=tmr.teamRoleId AND tr.teamId=tm.teamId AND tr.tenantId=tm.tenantId AND tr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_role_permissions trp ON trp.teamRoleId=tr.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=trp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='team.workflow.stage.override' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId2 AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') AS UNSIGNED) canOverride FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages fromStage ON fromStage.id=w.currentStageId AND fromStage.workflowId=w.id AND fromStage.tenantId=w.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages targetStage ON targetStage.id=:targetStage AND targetStage.workflowId=w.id AND targetStage.tenantId=w.tenantId AND targetStage.id<>fromStage.id AND targetStage.status<>'archived' WHERE w.id=:recordId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId3 AND w.currentStageId=:expectedStage LIMIT 1

sql.query: UPDATE tbl_tasks SET wasBypassedOnStageProgression=1,modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workflowId=:recordId AND workflowStageId=:fromStage AND tenantId=:tenantId AND isRequired=1 AND status NOT IN ('complete','skipped')

UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages SET status=CASE WHEN status='not_started' THEN 'in_progress' ELSE status END,startedDate=COALESCE(startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:stageId AND workflowId=:recordId AND tenantId=:tenantId

INSERT INTO tbl_record_stage_history (tenantId,workflowId,workflowTemplateId,fromStageId,toStageId,transitionType,readinessResult,approvedByUserId,overrideReason,approvalComment,blockingTaskCount,onHoldTaskCount,missingResponseCount) VALUES (:tenantId,:recordId,:templateId,:fromStage,:toStage,'manual_override',CASE WHEN :blocking=0 AND :holds=0 AND :missing=0 THEN 'ready_for_approval' WHEN :holds2>0 OR :missing2>0 THEN 'blocked' ELSE 'not_ready' END,:userId,:reason,NULLIF(:notes,''),:blocking2,:holds3,:missing3)

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,afterJson,createdDate) VALUES (:tenantId,:userId,:recordId,'workflow',:recordId2,'workflow.stage.overridden',CONCAT(:actor,' overrode progression from ',:fromName,' to ',:toName),JSON_OBJECT('transitionType','manual_override','fromStageId',:fromStage,'toStageId',:toStage,'reason',:reason,'blockingTaskCount',:blocking,'onHoldTaskCount',:holds,'missingResponseCount',:missing),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
